note: APPARENT (in-sample, resubstitution) performance only: the added biomarkers and the 21 model covariates are fitted and scored on the SAME MIMIC-III rows, with no held-out data. This therefore OVERSTATES performance and must not be read as a validated increment. It is reported solely to quantify what the deliberately cross-database-intersected 21-variable model omits: the heart-failure-specific markers that exist in only the MIMIC-III file.
estimand: apparent resubstitution AUC on the MIMIC-III exploratory cohort
